newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-DE BROE WANTS BITE OF NEW ROKISHKIS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-DE BROE WANTS BITE OF NEW ROKISHKIS ISSUE.

text.p: Williams De Broe confirmed on Tuesday that it was in talks with Rokishkis Cheese over the Lithuanian company's new issue of 200,000 shares.
"We are in talks with Rokishkis Cheese on these new shares," Williams De Broe managing director Petri Karjalainen told Reuters. Karjalainen declined to say when he expected a result from the talks.
De Broe already has a stake of around 12.5 percent in the cheese maker, which is one of three corporates on the top official list of Lithuania's stock exchange.
"We have acquired shares in Rokishkis previously," Karjalainen said.
"We think it's a good company. It's the leading dairy company in Lithuania," Karjalainen added.
Rokishkis shareholders decided on Friday to issue the 200,000 new shares with a face value of 10 litas.
The shareholders decided that the minimum selling price for the shares would be 44 litas and current shareholders will have no priority rights to buy into the issue.

Rokishkis Cheese Director General Antanas Trumpa told Reuters Monday that the company was in talks with foreign investors to acquire the whole issue and that one of the potential investors could be Williams De Broe.
Trumpa also said that the main condition for the investor is that it convert some of the company's shares quoted on the bourse and the whole of the new issue into GDRs.
